scope: Committed-publication sharing, fair bounded push delivery and existing Runtime progress continuation; unchanged ABI-2 wire payloads and native library.

configurationDefaults.notes: Time is a cooperative deadline, not preemption; native Busy staging copies are bounded by calls/candidates/time, while byte accounting counts accepted bodies.

limitations: The serial-writer debug comparison has the same workload shape and client source as the previous qualification, but its offered rate depends on confirmed replies. It is not a fixed-offered-load speedup claim.
Release paced runs use a requested 100 ms admission schedule and record lateness; a serial writer cannot maintain it through a long reply pause.

GemStone still shows occasional multi-second writer/server-drive pauses, including at one observer. The fan-out fairness defect is corrected, but a hard maximum freshness/latency guarantee is not established; the pause cause remains unconfirmed.
Connection ceiling remains 64 and the largest qualification is 60 observers plus a writer. This does not qualify hundreds/thousands of connections.
The isolated cost example measures encoding/cache work, not whole-server CPU or per-recipient TLS/network cost.

crossPlatformPush.notes: GT Swift and Unreal used separate disposable fixtures after a project startup failure; see complete evidence.
